clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Lakeshire’s smithy, Verner Osgood keeps the forge working. He balances local trade with the Stormwind Guard’s demands for horseshoes, weapons, and armor as gnolls raid the hills.

At Lakeshire’s forge, Verner Osgood makes horseshoes and other supplies for the town. His stock is constantly taken to make weapons and armor for the Stormwind Guard. With the kingdom’s forces stretched thin and local garrisons short on supplies, Verner carries much of the burden of keeping Redridge’s defenders equipped.

Gnoll raids threaten Verner’s work as well as the town’s horses. Packs ambush livestock in the Redridge hills and seize working horses that stray beyond Lakeshire. Verner recruits travelers to hunt the marauders and their packleader, Yowler.
